Buying · returns · refunds

Returns & refunds. 30 days from delivery or pickup.

Changed your mind, or something isn’t right? New items bought from i9Store USA can come back within 30 days of delivery, or of pickup at the Miami showroom. If an item comes back as new, there’s no fee.

The policy in short

Return window30 days from delivery or pickup
Holiday extensionBought November 1 – January 1: returnable through February 1.
Restocking feeNone if as new · 15% minimum if it can’t be resold as new
RefundWithin 7 business days of inspection, to the original payment
Applies toNew items from i9Store USA

01 · Start a return

Ask first, then send it or bring it.

Every return starts with a return authorization (RMA) number. Ask for one from the order in your account, by e-mail or on WhatsApp.

E-mailcontato@i9tv.com.br Phone+1 (305) 333-4374 WhatsAppTalk to a specialist

What to tell us

  • Your order number, from the receipt e-mail.
  • The item and its serial number: we check it against the order.
  • Its condition: unopened, opened, or not working.
  • For damage or a defect: what you see, and when the order arrived.
Cam 2RMA

02 · What happens next

From RMA number to refund.

  1. Step 1

    You get an RMA number

    We reply with the number and how to send the item back.

  2. Step 2

    Ship it, or bring it

    Ship it to Miami with the label we generate (its cost comes off the refund), or drop it at the showroom, Monday to Friday, 9 am–5 pm.

  3. Step 3

    We inspect it

    We check the condition and that the serial number matches your order.

  4. Step 4

    The refund goes out

    Within 7 business days of the inspection, to the payment method you used. Sales tax comes back with it.

Before you pack it

  • Reset and unlock it. Cameras, recorders and anything with an account or a passcode come back reset, unlocked and removed from your account (DJI, for example). Locked devices aren’t accepted.
  • Pack everything. The original box, the packaging, accessories, manuals, blank warranty cards and any free gift.
  • Picked it up in Miami? The 30 days start on the pickup day.

03 · Condition

Comes back as new: no fee.

The restocking fee only applies when an item can’t be resold as new.

  • As newIn the original box, unaltered, with all the packaging, accessories, manuals, blank warranty cards and free gifts. No restocking fee.
  • Not as newOpened or missing packaging, signs of use, a broken seal: a restocking fee of at least 15%.
  • Serial numberMust match the one on your order.
  • Free giftsA gift that doesn’t come back is deducted at its retail value.

04 · Exceptions

What can’t come back.

Some items can’t be resold once opened, and some are made or set up for you.

Not returnable once opened

Opened, it stays

  • Software and licenses
  • Batteries
  • Memory cards
  • Consumables, such as film and lamps
  • Computers and tablets
  • Drones
  • Monitors of 37 inches or more

Never returnable

Made or set up for you

  • Special orders
  • Equipment configured to your order
  • Items marked “final sale” on the product page

Different terms

Open-box, demo and used

This policy covers new items. Open-box, demo and used items follow the terms written on their product page.

05 · Damaged, dead on arrival or defective

Tell us quickly. We pay the return.

When we confirm a defect, return shipping is on us, and if the mistake was ours, the original shipping comes back too.

What happens with a damaged or defective item, by when you tell us
When you tell usWhat happens
Damaged in shippingWithin 2 business days of deliveryWe need it this soon to claim with the carrier. Keep the box and the packaging.
Defect or dead on arrivalWithin 5 business days of delivery or pickupA refund or an exchange.
DefectWithin 30 days of delivery or pickupAn exchange or a repair.
After 30 daysWarrantyThe i9Store USA or manufacturer warranty, with the terms on the product page.

06 · Refunds, exchanges, cancellations

Back to the card you paid with.

Refunds go to the original payment method within 7 business days of the inspection.

  • Sales taxRefunded with the item.
  • DeductedThe restocking fee when it applies, and the return label if you used ours.
  • Original shippingRefunded only when the mistake was ours.
  • ExchangesA defective item is exchanged within the windows above. Rather have a different model? Talk to us before you send anything back.
  • Cancel before it shipsFull refund.
  • Late orderIf we can’t ship in the time we stated, we tell you and offer to cancel.

07 · Returns at the showroom

Bring it back in Miami.

Any return, shipped to you or picked up, can be dropped at the showroom with its RMA number. Nothing to ship, nothing deducted for a label. The same policy is posted at the counter.

08 · Orders shipped outside the US

International returns.

The same 30 days apply. The trip back, and the paperwork, are on the buyer. How international shipping works.

  • Return costsReturn shipping, and any export and import taxes, are paid by the buyer.
  • Destination taxesDuties and taxes paid in your country aren’t refunded by i9Store.
  • RefundIn US dollars, to the original payment method.
  • Refused packageIf you refuse the package, or don’t pay the duties and taxes, and it comes back to Miami: we refund what you paid minus the shipping both ways and any duty, tax, storage or fee billed to i9Store, after inspection. If sending it back costs more than the item, it may be abandoned, and then there’s no refund.
  • Our mistakeRefused because of a wrong item, damage or missing paperwork on our side: full refund, shipping included.
  • Before it comes backYou can ask for a new delivery by paying the duties, taxes and storage due.

Return questions.

Windows, fees, refunds and the showroom.

How long do I have to return an item?

Thirty days from delivery, or from pickup at the Miami showroom. Items bought from November 1 through January 1 can be returned through February 1.

Is there a restocking fee?

None if the item comes back as new. If it can’t be resold as new (opened or missing packaging, signs of use, a broken seal), a restocking fee of at least 15% applies.

How fast is the refund?

Within 7 business days after we inspect the return, to the original payment method. Sales tax comes back with it. The original shipping charge is refunded only if the mistake was ours.

Who pays for return shipping?

You do, unless we confirm a defect. Ship it with the label we generate, and its cost comes off the refund, or drop it at the Miami showroom.

Can I return an item at the Miami showroom?

Yes. Ask for your RMA number first, then bring the item Monday to Friday, 9 am–5 pm, whether it was shipped to you or picked up.

What if it arrives damaged or doesn’t work?

Damage from shipping: tell us within 2 business days of delivery. A defect reported within 5 business days gets a refund or an exchange; within 30 days, an exchange or a repair. After that, the warranty on the product page applies.

What can’t be returned?

Once opened: software and licenses, batteries, memory cards, consumables, computers, tablets, drones and monitors of 37 inches or more. Never: special orders, equipment configured to your order and items marked “final sale” on the product page.

I bought from i9Store Brasil. Does this apply?

No. Orders on the Brazilian marketplace are sold and invoiced by an official reseller, which handles returns under Brazilian law. This page covers orders from i9Store USA.
